title: While & Do-While Loops
description: Repeat code while a condition is true, and learn to avoid infinite loops.

slides.title: The While Loop 🔁

quizData.question: What will this loop do? int x = 1; while (x < 5) { x++; }
quizData.explanation: x starts at 1, increments until 5, then condition x < 5 becomes false, loop exits.

slides.title: Infinite Loops & Break 🛑

quizData.question: What does the 'continue' keyword do inside a loop?

options.text: Skips the rest of the current iteration and moves to the next
Restarts the loop from the beginning

quizData.explanation: 'continue' jumps to the loop condition check for the next iteration.

slides.title: Do-While Loop 🔂

quizData.question: A do-while loop will always run its body at least once, even if the condition is false.
quizData.explanation: The condition is evaluated after the first execution, so the body runs at least once.

slides.title: ⚠️ Watch Out!
slides.content:
## Avoid While in Update

Don't put a long or infinite while loop inside `Update()` without yield; it will freeze the entire game. Use coroutines with `yield return null` for timed loops.
